purpose: Teach: 公庫/汎用/中級/勘案/解禁/焼却/税法/公述

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、政策金融公庫の融資を活用しろ
lines.en: We need to leverage the Policy Finance Corporation's loan programs.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for hesitation. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の汎用部品の需要が伸びております
lines.en: Yes, sir. Demand for our general-purpose components has been growing steadily.
lines.style: Respectful and precise. Speaks clearly without rush. Eyes up — meeting his gaze. The confidence of someone who has done his homework and can back up what he's saying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員研修は中級コースから始めよ
lines.en: Start the staff training program with the intermediate level course.
lines.style: Measured directive. No inflection that invites negotiation. Brief pause before 'intermediate' — the word itself carries weight. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、市場動向を勘案して戦略を立てます
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll factor in current market conditions and build our strategy accordingly.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Slight formal lift on 'factor in' — showing he's thought this through. Calm assurance, not reassurance-seeking. Grounded in data.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の解禁、来月に予定しろ
lines.en: Schedule the new product launch for next month.
lines.style: Crisp, final. The words land like checkmarks on a list. No elaboration needed. The tone of someone closing one item to move to the next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い書類は焼却処分いたします
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll ensure the old documentation is properly destroyed.
lines.style: Formal politeness. Slight emphasis on 'properly' — showing attention to procedure. Respectful but not obsequious. The tone of someone executing orders with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 税法改正に対応した経理体制を整えろ
lines.en: Update our accounting department to comply with the new tax regulations.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Measured pace. Weight on 'comply' — making clear this is non-negotiable. The tone of someone who knows regulatory landscapes demand precision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。公述人として国会で証言される件、対応いたします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll handle the arrangements for your testimony before the Diet.
lines.style: Formal closing tone. Slight deepening of voice on 'arrangements' — showing he understands the gravity. Respectful, competent. The last response of a meeting that has concluded.
